description: Source file implementing SPDY/HTTP2 metadata extension handling, including frame sequence generation, metadata support detection, and payload processing.

classes.name: MetadataFrameSequence

classes.description: Processes SPDY/HTTP2 metadata frames, manages support detection, and decodes HPACK-encoded metadata payloads.

methods.description: Checks if there are more frames to generate.

methods.name: MetadataFrameSequence::Next
methods.description: Generates the next metadata frame, respecting maximum frame size.

methods.description: Handles SPDY/HTTP2 settings to determine metadata support.

methods.name: MetadataVisitor::OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Processes frame headers, initializes payload state for metadata frames.

methods.name: MetadataVisitor::OnFramePayload
methods.description: Accumulates payload data, decodes HPACK-encoded metadata when complete.
